_doc: Grandfathered hits of scripts/check-race-class.mjs, as of 2026-09-12. May only SHRINK: a key that stops matching fails src/test/raceClassGuard.test.ts until deleted here. Never add a key to get green — lock the read or add the status predicate instead.

allow.sql:public.notify_on_application: Reads only title + customer_id (never change after posting) to address a notification; no status decision.
allow.sql:public.flag_suspicious_review: Fraud heuristic over budget/timestamps; a stale read mis-scores one flag, never a lifecycle or money state.
allow.sql:public.enforce_open_job_limit: COUNT across a poster's open jobs (a set, not a row lock); a race lets one extra open job through, cap is soft abuse control.
allow.sql:public.notify_helpers_on_job_post: Fan-out of job-match notifications on the INSERTed job's own NEW values; jobs read is a candidate filter only.
allow.sql:public.notify_helper_on_tip: Reads job title for notification copy after payment_status flips; no decision on job state.
allow.sql:public.enforce_review_validity: Gates a review INSERT on job completed + participant; completed is terminal, so a concurrent cancel cannot un-complete it. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.sweep_job_start_reminders: Cron reminder sweep; worst race outcome is one reminder on a job cancelled in the same instant.
allow.sql:public.sweep_no_show_alerts: Cron alert sweep; worst race outcome is one alert on a job that changed status in the same instant.
allow.sql:public.sweep_daily_job_digest: Daily digest notification over open jobs; informational only.
allow.sql:public.detect_suspicious_user_patter: Aggregate fraud-flag cron over jobs; writes only fraud_flags for admin review.
allow.sql:public.detect_stuck_payments: Cron detector writing error_logs + admin notifications; no money movement.
allow.sql:public.reject_other_applications_on_: Ownership/membership EXISTS over applications JOIN jobs; caller must already own the job. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.rpc_decide_dispute: Reads customer_id/helper_id/title (participants, immutable once hired) for notifications; dispute row itself is the decision. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.notify_helper_application_vie: Reads job title for notification copy; no decision on job state.
allow.sql:public.respond_to_direct_offer: Main status read is FOR UPDATE (raced 0/20 on prod 2026-09-12); remaining hit is the INSERT ... SELECT FROM jobs for the decline notification after the lock is held.
allow.sql:public.sweep_dayof_confirm_reminders: Cron reminder sweep; worst race outcome is one reminder on a job that changed in the same instant.
allow.sql:public.enforce_application_credentia: Reads credential_tier to gate the application INSERT; tier is set at posting. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.apply_to_job: Status read is already FOR SHARE; remaining hit is the self-apply EXISTS on customer_id, which never changes on a live job.
allow.sql:public.reject_pending_job: Admin rejection of a pending post; reads business_id + notification copy. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.notify_user_on_review: Reads title + customer_id for notification copy; no decision on job state.
allow.sql:public.purge_user_data: Account deletion; the jobs read selects the deleting user's own unfunded, unhired jobs. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.sql:public.notifications_fill_job_id: EXISTS check that a job id is real before stamping notifications.job_id; no lifecycle decision.
allow.sql:public.snapshot_application_job_poin: Copies rounded job coordinates onto the application at INSERT; coordinates are not lifecycle state.
allow.sql:public.open_dispute_as: Primary job read is FOR UPDATE; remaining hit is a velocity/fraud-flag read in the same body. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.client:src/components/JobConfirmation.ts: Computed-key day-of confirmation stamp; field set is helper_dayof/poster confirmations. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.client:src/components/JobTracking.tsx::o: stampJob(patch) helper for poster tracker stamps; payload typed TablesUpdate<"jobs">. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.client:src/components/PhotoProof.tsx::op: Payload is proof_before_urls / proof_after_urls only (not lifecycle); opaque to the parser because it is a variable.
allow.client:src/components/activity/Completio: Legacy revision_requested write kept for pre-RPC read paths. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.client:src/components/activity/EditJobDi: Poster edit of job details (title, schedule, expires_at); lifecycle columns not in the object. Opaque because it is a variable.
allow.client:src/components/activity/appliedJo: Payload is dispute_helper_response (+ dispute_status), not job status; opaque because it is a variable.
allow.client:src/components/admin/AdminDispute: Admin-only dispute close; admin is the arbiter of that job's status. Not yet re-audited under this class.
allow.client:src/components/admin/AdminJobs.ts: Admin-only removal (status cancelled); intended to win over any concurrent state. Not yet re-audited under this class.
